field_rules.source_id: Entry/id in complete raw annual scope; version suffix removed. d0112.csv.source_path binds inventory provenance.
field_rules.eligibility: Annual entry/published is in 2020 UTC and entry/category includes cs.LG. Current source HTML withdrawal banner and latest listed history checked. Full comment manual adjudication in review files.
field_rules.source_last_submission_utc: Maximum listed UTC timestamp in source HTML Submission history; agrees with annual Atom updated.
field_rules.target_id: Direct outgoing named target in full source comment. Numeric direction checked; two title identities separately evidenced in candidate_pool.json.relations.
field_rules.target_version: All versions attaining the greatest target-history timestamp no later than source cutoff.
field_rules.target_submission_utc: Selected target history row; independently agrees with version-specific Atom updated.
field_rules.target_title: Selected-version HTML h1 and Atom title agree after entity decoding, NFC and whitespace normalization. No semantic title aliases.

publisher_relation: candidate_pool.json.publisher_relation and publisher_evidence.json; excluded without invented ID/version
stability: Saved selected versions have permanent identifiers and dated histories. Current records agree with pre-anchor metadata updates. Administrative edits without new versions cannot be ruled out; no perfect archival snapshot is claimed.
